hypothesis: Intersect the conditioned function equation with quadratic-support image space before generating coefficients, reducing rejected function candidates without losing any admissible relation.
scope: Exploratory point-decomposition stage; not an end-to-end ECDLP or novelty-in-the-literature claim.
curve: y^2+xy=x^3+1 over type-II normal-basis binary fields
domain: Three distinct nonzero x values in span of first d basis vectors, each different from target x; exact signed sum required.
budget_semantics: Existing cooperative all-phase deadlines, including setup and checking; record any overrun. No hard wall-time or RAM guarantee.
validation: All 43 affine five-bit targets: exact projected-set equality to independent group pair oracle; compare full valid coefficient sets between image baseline and pullback. Larger outputs checked against exact pair oracle; completed enumerations must be equal.
rejection_rule: Any lost/invalid relation fails correctness. If pullback is slower or uses more field operations on the complete paired panel, retain it as a negative result and do not promote it.
exploratory_target: At least 20 percent fewer all-phase counted field API operations per verified relation versus quadratic-image on complete, equal-output cells; inspect multiplications, additions and squarings separately. This is not the normalized full-cost gate.
boundary: The method still scans O(2^(2d)) conditioned (h2,z) branches; each image has rank d-1, with at most two image preimages per nonzero-target branch. The generic uniform-target support bound remains unchanged.
operation_conversion: None measured between field API operations and SAT counters or rho. No cross-engine operation ratio or end-to-end speedup will be claimed.
benchmark_adapter: WDSat frozen corpus uses a=1 and a different polynomial protocol. This a=0 function-coefficient chart instead uses the repository's matched S3/S4 adapters under the parent accounting contract; fixed regression evidence remains untouched.
holdout_policy: Exclude exact targets in all existing solver_02 through solver_09 raw records. These new targets become development data after this run. Single-run timing is diagnostic only.
